task: Extend the Windows PowerShell hook pin (currently Claude-only) to the Gemini install and its repair migrations in codemie-code so Gemini hooks stop flashing an empty cmd.exe window (EPMCDME-16975).

key_reasoning.reason: Scored XL (base L, bumped): touches the shared installer core BaseExtensionInstaller.ts (hookHost gate at line 532) and the shared utility src/utils/hook-command.ts (rewriteHooksCommandTree, resolveHookCommand), which is also imported by migrations 006/008 and codemie-code.plugin.ts. Four components across the installer, utility, migration and agent-asset layers. The OTLP connector (claude-code-otlp.ts:341) is out of scope per NG4.

Scored L: ACs AC1-AC6 are concrete and D1/D2 are decided, but two open questions change the shared contract. Scope risk Q1: widening the shared pin rule to plain-path Claude installs would change AC6 and the shared rule. Scope risk Q2: repairing users who never relaunch codemie-gemini needs a new migration id, which adds a migration file. The Gemini hook shell behaviour is also unverified and is settled only by the manual AC1 check.

Scored XXL: no exact precedent for the Gemini path (the pin exists only for Claude, CHANGELOG 0.16.3). The fix depends on Gemini CLI honouring a per-hook shell field, which is unverified and lives outside this repo (external dependency of unknown reliability). Base L, then bumped to XL for the data-migration red flag (migrations 006 and 008 rewrite installed hook files on upgrade), then to XXL for enumerated edge cases (AC4 non-Windows, AC5 unresolvable binary path) with no win32 hook test template (BaseExtensionInstaller-windows.test.ts has no hook or shell assertions). The pin also only fires for a quoted binary (hook-command.ts:115, :155). Calibration: the L example epmcdme-10401 scored a config migration for existing users at L; this assessment is higher because of the unverified external executor and the edge-case bump. The total band is unaffected.

Scored L (bumped from M): requires data migration. Modified files are about 5-7 across agents/core/extension, agents/plugins/gemini, migrations and utils (BaseExtensionInstaller.ts, gemini.extension-installer.ts, 006 migration, hook-command.ts possibly, migrations/index.ts registration). New files are about 2-3: a win32 Gemini installer test, a 008 test (none exists), and a new migration file if Q2 is taken.
